html:
I just wanted to post a quick update letting you know that Once Dead has gone into production at my publisher and the scheduled release date looks like August 8th.  As for Nine-Tenths of the Law, I will be delivering the manuscript to my publisher in late February.

Richard

comments.author: Cathy
comments.html: Thanks for the update, I’m currently re listening to the Rho Agenda prior to reviews and enjoying it all over again!

comments.author: Steve
comments.html: Great. Good luck with “Once Dead”, and can’t wait for “9 Tenths to finish” Really enjoy reading the updates.

replies.author: Richard Phillips
replies.html:
Thanks Steve. Looking forward to finishing the draft and getting started on the next book … no name yet.
Richard

comments.author: Jim
comments.html: I just finished reading what you posted as the rough draft of Nine tenths of the law. I have to tell you that I found it even more enjoyable than Once Dead. And there is nothing rough about it. It is a fine piece of work. I cant wait for the rest of it….

replies.author: Richard Phillips
replies.html:
Thanks Jim,
I’m closing in on finishing the draft and will be delivering it to my publisher before the end of the month.
Richard

comments.author: Paul Keyworth-Wright
comments.html:
hello Richard
Does the book come out on Kindle at the same time as hardback release? If not do you know how long we would have to wait.

replies.author: Richard Phillips
replies.html:
Hi Paul,
Once Dead is scheduled to be released on Audiobook, paperback, and kindle on the same day, 19 August 2014.
Richard
